user_model.description: SQLAlchemy User model with credential hashing, session tokens, quotas, roles, and SSO subject links.
user_model.reuse_for: Base identity record for all clinic users; local accounts first, Entra linked via user.id without auto-linking.

recording_model.description: SQLAlchemy Recording model storing audio metadata, duration, transcript segments, language, and status.
recording_model.reuse_for: Core dictation entity; extended via clinic domain relations under src/clinic/ (non-destructive revisions, patient/KIS context).

group_membership_models.description: Group, GroupMembership, Folder, and RecordingTag models with role-based access control.
group_membership_models.reuse_for: Foundation for clinical author and transcriptionist pools; segregated into distinct author/pool visibility boundaries.

storage_services.description: Abstract storage backend interfaces, local filesystem implementation, S3 adapter, and quota enforcement.
storage_services.reuse_for: Encapsulated dictation audio and revision artifact persistence with strict tenant isolation and path validation.

export.description: Markdown-to-DOCX conversion, text rendering, attachment responses, and automated export templates.
export.reuse_for: Clinical document export for approved dictation transcripts into docx and formatted text templates for KIS transfer.

browser_recorder_and_asr_editor.description: Vue 3 web audio capture (MediaRecorder), segment-level waveform editor, word-aligned timeline, and chunk persistence.
browser_recorder_and_asr_editor.reuse_for: Primary web-only clinical recording, live dictation feedback, and transcriptionist correction workbench with minimum 16 undo steps.

audio_player.description: HTML5 audio player composable managing playback state, rate control, scrubbing, and position tracking.
audio_player.reuse_for: Audio playback in the web review and correction views; foot pedal integration hooks attach to its playback APIs.

processing_job_and_queue.description: FairJobQueue asynchronous multi-threaded task runner with database-backed job states, priority, and retry tracking.
processing_job_and_queue.reuse_for: Sole async processing pipeline for ASR transcription, alignment, and clinic background operations; no new queue framework.

auth_login_sso.description: Authentication endpoints, session lifecycle, CSRF tokens, lockout mitigation, and OIDC/SSO integration logic.
auth_login_sso.reuse_for: Local username/password login initially; Entra ID adapter pre-wired under src/clinic/ and enabled via server profile.

admin_ui.description: Tabler-based administrative views for user management, system metrics, group configurations, and policy flags.
admin_ui.reuse_for: Identity admin management of clinical author and secretarial pools; isolated from clinical audio content inspection.

audit_log.description: AuditEvent model, IP/user auditing decorator and emitter, retention policy, and coverage assertions.
audit_log.reuse_for: HIPAA/clinical compliance audit logging for every access to patient dictation recordings, transcripts, and exports.

api_tokens.description: Hashed bearer API tokens with scope enforcement for external programmatic access.
api_tokens.reuse_for: Machine-to-machine authentication for the local apps/windows-import agent; disabled for arbitrary user self-service in clinic mode.

public_share.description: Unauthenticated public share tokens for streaming audio and viewing transcripts outside the organization.
public_share.reuse_for: Strictly disabled in clinic deployment; retained in code for baseline test compatibility but blocked by route policy.

chat_inquire.description: Agentic transcript Q&A, LLM tool execution, chat threads, and streaming response delivery.
chat_inquire.reuse_for: Disabled in clinic default profile to avoid unverified LLM hallucinations; inspectable only with local verified models.

webhooks.description: Webhook endpoint registry, HMAC signature generation, and background asynchronous delivery thread.
webhooks.reuse_for: Event notifications for clinic workflow integration (e.g. dictation available for pool, transcript completed).

feature_flags_and_config.description: Environment configuration parser, startup safety checks, theme styling, and database SystemSetting overrides.
feature_flags_and_config.reuse_for: Clinic configuration defaults, enforcement of local-only ASR, and immutable startup security flags.

db_migration_mechanism.description: One-shot programmatic migration ledger (schema_migrations table, run_once helper, dynamic column/index addition).
db_migration_mechanism.reuse_for: Execution of clinic schema additions and indexes under src/clinic/migrations/ without introducing Alembic.

recording_retention_archive.description: Recording-wide retention archival with mandatory transactional audit events, an append-only archive ledger, personal archive compatibility and additive legacy-schema migration.
recording_retention_archive.reuse_for: Preserve originals, media, child rows, immutable revisions and exact version-bound releases while filtering archived recordings from active web lists. Reuse existing schedules, settings, archive controls and APIs.

verification.supplementary_runtime: Python 3.14.4, SQLite, explicit archive-runtime/sitecustomize.py import bootstrap

test_layout_and_ci.description: Pytest configuration with isolated SQLite database and disabled services; GitHub Actions CI running unit, postgres, and smoke suites.
test_layout_and_ci.reuse_for: Testing harness extended with clinic tests under tests/clinic/ to enforce domain rules and verify parity gates.
